name: VDH Used Stock Management
description:
NOTE:

VDH contains several APIs that are published in the OneAPI portal. The APIs can be easily identified by the “VDH” in the naming. This documentation is dedicated to the API “VDH Used Stock Management” that will replace the former VSE-Vehicle Management Service interface.

You can find an overview of all available VDH APIs on the VDH Product Page (https://vdh.mercedes-benz.com). Here you can also get additional information (e.g. support contact, business contact, Postman collections).

For Mercedes-Benz Retailers: The prerequisite for subscribing to this API is the signed VDH contract. If you have further questions regarding the contract, please contact your responsible Wholesale representative.

---
1\. Overview Vehicle Data Hub (VDH)
----------------------------------

VDH is the abbreviation for Vehicle Data Hub and stands for a set of services offered by Mercedes-Benz AG. The aim of the VDH APIs is to support the remarketing of vehicles within the Mercedes-Benz Retail organization. VDH aggregates data and provides complete vehicle data objects to Dealer Management Systems (DMS) and all other consumers. In addition, VDH provides complete vehicle data objects to Mercedes-Benz customer front-ends for the online offer of vehicles. VDH offers these services only for Mercedes-Benz passenger cars (incl. model ranges of smart until 2022), and Mercedes-Benz Vans (private and commercial ones).

The VDH consists of the following APIs that are published and documented in the OneAPI Portal:

**VDH Used Stock Management**

A user is able to upload or modify a vehicle to/from VDH. In addition to this, a user is able to change the status of a vehicle (e.g. by reserving it) and/or select the sales channels, where a vehicle should be offered.

**VDH Vehicle Data (VIN/FIN dependent)**

A user is able to obtain a complete vehicle data object. This data includes e.g. factory data, standard & special equipment incl. corresponding marketing texts/descriptions. This service is VIN/FIN based.

**VDH Vehicle Master Data (VIN/FIN independent)**

A user is able to obtain general vehicle information. This catalogue data includes e.g. attributes of vehicles like colors or trims incl. corresponding marketing texts/descriptions. This service is independent of a specific VIN/FIN.

**VDH Search**

A user is able to search for vehicles within the VDH stock. Search parameters could be model type, color, location, VIN/FIN, etc. This API is not intended for retailer/dealer usage.

**VDH Media Management**

A user is able to upload and edit vehicle media (e.g. photos). The provided vehicle media is stored for a defined vehicle and shown at selected online sales channels to the end customer.

**VDH MVIS**

A user is able to rapidly retrieve marketing information for a specific VIN/FIN. VDH MVIS acts as a cache layer for VDH Vehicle Data (VIN/FIN dependent), enabling fast retrieval of information without the need of collecting the data from original sources. This API is not intended for retailer/dealer usage.

---
2\. VDH Used Stock Management
---------------------------------


### 1. Introduction

The VDH Used Stock Management is the central service for uploading vehicles to the vehicle stock of VDH or to modify existing vehicles already saved in the vehicle stock of VDH.

submitting vehicle data (e.g. mileage, damage descriptions, number of previous owners, offer price, first registration date) to the vehicle stock of VDH.

For our service, the consumer can insert the vehicle in his national language. Afterwards it is possible to retrieve the vehicle data in additional languages so that the vehicle has not to be saved in multiple languages.

In addition to that, it is possible to modify existing vehicles that have been already saved in the vehicle stock. For each update of a vehicle, a dealer management system (DMS) has to report all necessary data fields. These data include dealer information, vehicle equipment, technical data, etc. The data input serves as basis for creating, updating, reserving, ordering, deleting, selling a vehicle, and cancelling a vehicle sale. In order to ensure a high data quality, VDH performs a validation service, when vehicle data is uploaded to or updated within the VDH vehicle stock.

Over a separate endpoint of this API, it is possible to perform reservations and orders for vehicles by other systems. If a vehicle reservation or sale is reported, the respective vehicle will be removed directly from the vehicle stock and therefore, will no longer be visible in the digital sales channels.

With the Used Stock Management Service, dealers are able to synchronize their local vehicle stock in real time to the global vehicle stock of the VDH database.

For Mercedes-Benz owned brands, these include EQ and AMG, an automated enrichment of the vehicle data is performed in the background in order to retrieve additional information like official sales descriptions, and standard and special equipment codes of a vehicle. The same is valid for Smart models up to 2022.

For foreign brands, there is no enrichment service available, so that the complete information about a vehicle has to be provided by the user. In that case, VDH only stores the respective vehicle information.


### 2. Controllers

The API VDH Used Stock Management contains the following controllers:

**Assign Bulk to Marketplaces**

This controller can be used to assign a new marketplace, e.g. Mercedes-Benz Web page for a bulk of vehicles. It can (re-)assign all the vehicles of an outled ID or marketplace to a new marketplace. In order to unassgined a bulk of vehicles from a market place, the target marketplace in the request should remain empty.

**Change Vehicle Status**

This controller can be used to only change a vehicle's status. The remaining attributes of the vehicle remain the same. The controller Change Vehicle Status allows the following status transitions only:

* R: reserve vehicle
* Y: cancel vehicle reservation
* O: start vehicle order 
* C: confirm vehicle order
* W: cancel vehicle order
* V: sold vehicle
* I: inactive vehicle
* N: active vehicle
* X: update active vehicle
* Z: cancel sale
* S: update sales data

With this controller, it is possible to validate and save one or multiple vehicle status updates of one or multiple vehicles. The VIN/FIN serves as identifier for the respective vehicles.

**Read Vehicle**

This controller can be used to read all available attributes and texts of any vehicle from VDH. It is composed by two endpoints: Read and Read Status.

The Read endpoint can be used to read all available attributes and texts of any vehicle and provides the following services:

* Read vehicles by VIN/FIN
* Read vehicles by Owner

The execution of a specific service is controlled by the presence of VIN/FIN properties in the request. If VINs/FINs are provided, the service will try to fetch the respective vehicles, if no VINs/FINs are provided the service will fetch the vehicles owned by the requesting dealer. Only vehicles that are owned by the requesting dealer can be read.

The Read Status endpoint can be used to read the status of any vehicle and provides the following service:

* Read vehicle status by VIN/FIN

The execution of a specific service is controlled by the presence of VIN/FIN properties in the request. If a VIN/FIN is provided, the service will retrieve the vehicle status of the respective vehicle in realtime from the stock database. Only vehicles that are stored in the vehicle stock or sales archive can be shown. If a vehicle is both in stock and sales archive, the one from stock will be returned. If a vehicle is in sales archive multiple times because it was sold multiple times via VDH, the last sold vehicle will be taken into consideration. Deleted vehicles will deliver no result.

New, updated or deleted vehicles data are synchronized with a maximum delay of 2 minutes to the VDH Search Index and are then available for all consumers in the digital sales channel by the VDH search interfaces This interface delivers the vehicle status without a delay.

**Save Vehicle**

This controller can be used to upload one or more vehicles to the VDH vehicle stock or to save any modification on one or more already existing vehicles. The controller provides the following services:

* Save vehicle
* Update vehicle
* Reserve vehicle / cancel reservation
* Start order / confirm order / cancel order
* Sell vehicle / cancel vehicle sale / update sales data

In order to use the services, the following conditions have to be fulfilled:

* A maximum of 10 vehicles is allowed for one Save Vehicle service call.
* Updates of existing vehicles have to be submitted with the intended vehicleStatus X, which means that a consumer has to know if a vehicle was already sent to the Save Vehicle controller. It is prohibited to execute a data delivery logic that basically consists of submitting all (new and already existing) vehicles on a daily basis as new (vehicleStatus X).

The Save Vehicle controller is composed by the two endpoints: Full and Slim. The above-described services are available via the Save Vehicle Full endpoint.

The Save Vehicle Slim endpoint is a lightweight variant of the above-described Save Vehicle Full endpoint. The aim of this method is to also enable the take-in of vehicles.

The Save Vehicle Slim endpoint expects only the necessary stock information such as a price, mileage, damage descriptions. Factory vehicle data is not expected, as the enrichment process will start independently after the vehicle is saved via the Save Slim method. In addition to that, the Save Vehicle Slim can also be used to transfer specific equipment codes to the vehicle. This might be necessary to control discounts or financing codes so that subsequent systems, such as OCAPI, can calculate on a realistic basis.

New, updated or deleted vehicles data are synchronized with a maximum delay of 2 minutes to the VDH Search Index.


**Vehicle Management Health**

The Vehicle Management Health Service verifies the operational status of the API VDH Used Stock Management and indicates if the services provided by the API are available.


### 3. Validation

**Validation of Vehicle Data**

In order to provide the best possible data quality for the digital sales channel, the Save Vehicle controller performs several validations when a vehicle is submitted.

In general the validation can be categorized in two different steps:

* Check if all mandatory attributes are provided

	The service checks if the basic set of the vehicle attributes are provided, which are necessary for all use cases. These attributes are marked as mandatory in request documentation.

* Check if the vehicle or the use case specific validation rules are violated

	The service provides a vehicle and use case specific configuration of validation rules - these validation rules are not checked in all cases, but depending on the actual vehicle category or use case which is submitted (e.g. if the sales date and sales price are provided when a vehicle sale is sbumitted).

**Change Vehicle Status**

The VDH Used Stock Management stores the status of each vehicle in a individual Data Base (DB). The transition between different status is restricted, each use case has its own restrictions.

The status validation implementation allows on one hand to avoid creating/overriding vehicles that already exist. On the other hand, prevents modifications of reserved vehicles.

The following table shows the allowed status transitions. Additionally, it specifies the pre-conditions for a status change.


| Use Case | Interface Status | DB before | DB after | Pre-Condition |
| ----------- | ----------- | ----------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| Create inactive vehicle | I | -, I | I | Vehicle is not existent OR vehicle exists with status "inactive"|
| Create active vehicle | N | - | N | Vehicle is not existent AND vehicle is valid |
| Activate inactive vehicle | N | I | N | Vehicle exists with status "inactive" AND vehicle is valid |
| Update active vehicle | X | N | N | Vehicle exists with status "active" AND vehicle is valid AND vehicle is not reserved |
| Reserve active vehicle | R | N | R | Vehicle exists with status "active" AND vehicle is not reserved |
| Cancel reserved vehicle | Y | R | N | Vehicle is reserved |
| Start vehicle order | O | N, R | O | Vehicle exists with status "active" OR "reserved" |
| Confirm vehicle order | C | N, R, O | C | Vehicle exists with status "active" OR "reserved" OR "Order started" |
| Cancel vehicle order | W | O, C | N | Vehicle exists with status "Order started" OR "Order confirmed" |
| Sell vehicle | V | N, R, O, C | V | Vehicle exists with status "active" OR "reserved" OR "order started" OR "order confirmed" AND vehicle is valid |
| Cancel sale | Z | V | N | Vehicle exists in the sales archive AND vehicle is not in stock |
| Update sales data | S | V | V | Vehicle exists in sales archive with the sales date sent in the update-sales-data-request |
---
3\. Accessing the VDH services
----------------------------------
The services of the VDH are REST-based web services, which are only available via the OneAPI {HUB}. If you would like to use the API VDH Used Stock Management or one of the other VDH services, please subscribe via the OneAPI {HUB}. If you are a dealer, you need your GC-ID and IAM credentials for the subscription.

Please notice: 
A pre-requisite to get access to the VDH services is the signature of the “Agreement for Data Exchange in the Framework of the Vehicle Data Hub”. In case of any questions regarding this agreement, please get in touch with your contact person within your national wholesales organization!

If you want to allow your suppliers or service providers to use the services of VDH, you as a dealer have to subscribe on behalf of your suppliers or service providers. Please request separate credentials for each of your service provider following the OneAPI standard process.

---
4\. Operational Times
----------------------------------
The following overview provides the operation times and Service Level Agreements of the Vehicle Data Hub (VDH):
| Service KPI            | Service Level Agreement             |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------  |
| Operation Time         | Monday - Sunday from 00:00 to 24:00 |
| Availability           | 98,5 % per month                    |

---

Please ensure to address all operational or functional issues to VDH Support. If the VDH Support is not able to help directly, they will forward the issue automatically to further second and third level support instances.

---
6\. Demand Management
----------------------------------
If you have any further technical or business demands for this API, please send a detailed description of your requirements to the following e-mail address: demand-VDH@mercedes-benz.com

We evaluate any incoming demand and will come back to you, if an implementation within VDH is possible.

---
7\. Cost Information
----------------------------------
For Mercedes-Benz dealers, the use of VDH is free of charge. At the moment, the costs are covered by the national Wholesale Organization.
 
Additional fees may apply for future services that exceed the current scope of VDH services. In such case, the involved parties shall mutually agree on relevant fees.

For all other users, the run costs of the Vehicle Data Hub (VDH) are distributed based on the API usage of each consumer. The costs are due once a year.

---

----------------------------------

In general the validation can be categorized in two different steps:

* Check if all mandatory attributes are provided

	The service checks if the basic set of the vehicle attributes are provided, which are necessary for all use cases. These attributes are marked as mandatory in request documentation.

* Check if the vehicle or the use case specific validation rules are violated

	The service provides a vehicle and use case specific configuration of validation rules - these validation rules are not checked in all cases, but depending on the actual vehicle category or use case which is submitted (e.g. if the sales date and sales price are provided when a vehicle sale is sbumitted).

**Change Vehicle Status**

The VDH Used Stock Management stores the status of each vehicle in a individual Data Base (DB). The transition between different status is restricted, each use case has its own restrictions.

The status validation implementation allows on one hand to avoid creating/overriding vehicles that already exist. On the other hand, prevents modifications of reserved vehicles.

The following table shows the allowed status transitions. Additionally, it specifies the pre-conditions for a status change.


| Use Case | Interface Status | DB before | DB after | Pre-Condition |
| ----------- | ----------- | ----------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| Create inactive vehicle | I | -, I | I | Vehicle is not existent OR vehicle exists with status "inactive"|
| Create active vehicle | N | - | N | Vehicle is not existent AND vehicle is valid |
| Activate inactive vehicle | N | I | N | Vehicle exists with status "inactive" AND vehicle is valid |
| Update active vehicle | X | N | N | Vehicle exists with status "active" AND vehicle is valid AND vehicle is not reserved |
| Reserve active vehicle | R | N | R | Vehicle exists with status "active" AND vehicle is not reserved |
| Cancel reserved vehicle | Y | R | N | Vehicle is reserved |
| Start vehicle order | O | N, R | O | Vehicle exists with status "active" OR "reserved" |
| Confirm vehicle order | C | N, R, O | C | Vehicle exists with status "active" OR "reserved" OR "Order started" |
| Cancel vehicle order | W | O, C | N | Vehicle exists with status "Order started" OR "Order confirmed" |
| Sell vehicle | V | N, R, O, C | V | Vehicle exists with status "active" OR "reserved" OR "order started" OR "order confirmed" AND vehicle is valid |
| Cancel sale | Z | V | N | Vehicle exists in the sales archive AND vehicle is not in stock |
| Update sales data | S | V | V | Vehicle exists in sales archive with the sales date sent in the update-sales-data-request |

3\. Accessing the VDH services
----------------------------------
The services of the VDH are REST-based web services, which are only available via the OneAPI {HUB}. If you would like to use the API VDH Used Stock Management or one of the other VDH services, please subscribe via the OneAPI {HUB}. If you are a dealer, you need your GC-ID and IAM credentials for the subscription.

Please notice: 
A pre-requisite to get access to the VDH services is the signature of the “Agreement for Data Exchange in the Framework of the Vehicle Data Hub”. In case of any questions regarding this agreement, please get in touch with your contact person within your national wholesales organization!

If you want to allow your suppliers or service providers to use the services of VDH, you as a dealer have to subscribe on behalf of your suppliers or service providers. Please request separate credentials for each of your service provider following the OneAPI standard process.
